2247:             return Vec::new();

2250:         let mut colon_count = node_text(node, source).matches(':').count();
2251:         let mut end_byte = node.end_byte();

2254:             if next.kind() == "ERROR" && node_text(next, source).starts_with(':') {
2255:                 colon_count += node_text(next, source).matches(':').count();
2256:                 end_byte = end_byte.max(next.end_byte());
2257:             }

2259:         if let Some(parent) = node.parent() {
2260:             if parent.kind() == "ERROR" {
2261:                 colon_count += node_text(parent, source).matches(':').count();
2262:                 end_byte = end_byte.max(parent.end_byte());
2263:             } else if let Some(next) = parent.next_named_sibling() {

3489:                         // dimension is fine for 1-D indexing but ambiguous for multi-D.

3498:                                 line: pos.row + 1,

3500:                                 fix: None,

3930: /// Count `printf`-style format specifiers in a format string (for CTPCT).
3931: ///
3932: /// Counts `%` followed by a conversion character. Escaped `%%`, `%*` width
3933: /// specifiers, and `%n$` positional specifiers are not counted.
3934: fn count_format_specifiers(fmt: &str) -> usize {
3935:     let chars: Vec<char> = fmt.chars().collect();
3936:     let mut count = 0;
3937:     let mut i = 0;
3938:     while i < chars.len() {
3939:         if chars[i] != '%' {
3940:             i += 1;
3941:             continue;
3942:         }
3943:         let j = i + 1;
3944:         if j >= chars.len() {
3945:             break;
3946:         }
3947:         if chars[j] == '%' {
3948:             i = j + 1;
3949:             continue;
3950:         }
3951:         if chars[j] == '*' {
3952:             let mut k = j + 1;
3953:             while k < chars.len() && !chars[k].is_ascii_alphabetic() {
3954:                 k += 1;
3955:             }
3956:             i = k + 1;
3957:             continue;
3958:         }
3959:         let mut k = j;
3960:         while k < chars.len() && chars[k].is_ascii_digit() {
3961:             k += 1;
3962:         }
3963:         if k < chars.len() && chars[k] == '$' {
3964:             let mut m = k + 1;
3965:             while m < chars.len() && !chars[m].is_ascii_alphabetic() {
3966:                 m += 1;
3967:             }
3968:             i = m + 1;
3969:             continue;
3970:         }
3971:         while k < chars.len() && "-+ #0".contains(chars[k]) {
3972:             k += 1;
3973:         }
3974:         while k < chars.len() && chars[k].is_ascii_digit() {
3975:             k += 1;
3976:         }
3977:         if k < chars.len() && chars[k] == '.' {
3978:             k += 1;
3979:             while k < chars.len() && chars[k].is_ascii_digit() {
3980:                 k += 1;
3981:             }
3982:         }
3983:         if k < chars.len() && chars[k].is_ascii_alphabetic() {
3984:             count += 1;
3985:             i = k + 1;
3986:         } else {
3987:             i = j;
3988:         }
3989:     }
3990:     count
3991: }

4794:     /// Collect rule IDs from every node in the subtree, dispatching through the

4796:     fn collect_diagnostics(
4797:         eng: &GoodPracticesEngine,
4798:         node: Node,
4799:         source: &str,
4800:         ids: &mut Vec<&'static str>,
4801:     ) {

4807:         ids.extend(eng.check(&ctx).iter().map(|d| d.rule_id));

4810:             collect_diagnostics(eng, child, source, ids);

4814:     /// Find all descendant nodes of the given kind.
4815:     fn all_descendants_of_kind<'a>(node: Node<'a>, kind: &str) -> Vec<Node<'a>> {

4817:         if node.kind() == kind {
4818:             result.push(node);
4819:         }
4820:         let mut cursor = node.walk();
4821:         for child in node.children(&mut cursor) {
4822:             result.extend(all_descendants_of_kind(child, kind));
4823:         }
4824:         result
4825:     }
